 VV St. Truiden and Brann: Recent results
 St. Truiden have two wins, no draws and two defeats from their last five competitive matches, scoring eight goals and conceding six. Most recently, they lost 2-1 at home to Oud-Heverlee Leuven in the Belgian league. They have, however, won their two most recent Conference League matches, including a 1-0 victory away to FC Midtjylland.
 Across their last five competitive matches, Brann have recorded three wins and two defeats, scoring twelve goals and conceding nine. They most recently beat Molde 3-2 in the Eliteserien. In their latest Conference League match, Brann won 4-1 away to FK Kauno Zalgiris.
